name: Jersey City
housing: Jersey City rentals range from brownstones and two- and three-family houses to large waterfront and Journal Square apartment towers.

localRules.text: Jersey City's Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260) is administered by the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations, which requires annual landlord registration statements.

tenantHelp.name: Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations
tenantHelp.what: rent control questions and tenant complaints

climate: Test the heat and radiators, and in low-lying areas check basements and ground floors for past flooding.
fact: Many Jersey City renters choose homes near PATH stations for the short trip into Manhattan.
